Match its understated hand-drawn Japanese manga charm: fine slightly uneven black ink outlines, plain flat shapes, flat uncolored hair without gloss, large expressive dark oval irises drawn with little vertical hatching, rounded cheeks, tiny uncertain open mouth, hand-hatched blush, relaxed oversized sleeves, compact bust composition. Avoid polished glossy game artwork, jewel eyes, gradients, airbrushing, shiny hair, 3D rendering, huge sparkling eyes, photorealism. Make a different original character with a fluffy chin-length bob, soft side locks, a small waterdrop hair clip, a simple soft beret with small rhythm star pin, broad sailor collar, roomy sleeves. She holds a SMALL original rhythm-game controller across her chest, visibly a compact rounded rectangular device with two round knobs and four large keys, simplified enough to stay readable. Actually transparent background, no text or watermark, no background diagonal lines. Fine inner facial lines but readable outer silhouette for web header icon.
